_readme: Prices from stores that are NOT Woolworths or Coles. Keyed by list_item for a
single product, OR by a category's synthetic '__group_<key>' when the
alternative doesn't map 1:1 to any one existing member (an app.js category
merges entries from BOTH its own group key and every member's own name - see
groupThirdEntries). Absent key = the row looks and behaves like any other.
Entry fields:
store   'chemist_warehouse' | 'priceline'  (see THIRD_STORES in utils.js)
name    product name AS SOLD there - the size in it drives the unit price,
same as everywhere else in this app
url     product page
price   shelf price in AUD
packs   OPTIONAL, count for items sold by the piece (nappies): unit price
becomes price/packs 'each' instead of $/100g
checked ISO date the price was last confirmed
Hand-maintained for now, but reachability is per-PAGE-TYPE, not per-site, and
was wrong in an earlier version of this note - checked directly, 2026-08-06:
Priceline    - product pages AND search are both a Cloudflare JS-challenge
shell (~1.3KB, no price) to an automated browser. Confirmed
twice, a day apart. Neither is reachable.
Chemist Wh.  - SEARCH is a client-side-only shell (empty __NEXT_DATA__,
title literally 'undefined'), but a PRODUCT PAGE (/buy/<id>/
<slug>) renders server-side with a real, current price - the
CW nappies entry below was fetched this way, live, not from
a cached snippet. So CW needs a URL-discovery step (Google's
own index works: site:chemistwarehouse.com.au <query>) rather
than a bot-evasion one - a materially smaller adapter than
Priceline needs, if either is ever built into the scraper.
